verdict.rationale: Box documents registrable webhooks that send notifications to a URL of your choice when content events occur, including V2 webhooks for file events, plus an event feed for subscribing to actions. The story also asks for verification and retry semantics, and none of the evidence describes signature verification or delivery retries. missing for 10: documented webhook signature/verification scheme, documented retry/redelivery semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, file events push to me — documented webhooks/change notifications fire when content changes, with verification and retry semantics spelled out

citations.quote: Webhooks allow you to monitor Box content for events, and receive notifications to a URL of your choice when they occur.
Create a V2 webhook that notifies your endpoint when a file is downloaded
The event feed provides a way for an application to subscribe to any actions performed by any user, users, or service in an enterprise.
